evals.prompt: Write a Sui Move module called `test_project::bulletin` that creates a shared Bulletin board. The Bulletin has key ability with id (UID) and messages (vector<String>) fields. Include: a public function `create` that creates a Bulletin with an empty vector and shares it using transfer::share_object, taking ctx (&mut TxContext). A public function `post` that takes &mut Bulletin and message (String), and pushes the message onto the vector. Use Move 2024 edition syntax.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build

evals.prompt: Write a Sui Move module called `test_project::inventory` that uses dynamic object fields. Define a Player object (has key, store) with id (UID) and name (String). Include a public function `create_player` that takes name (String) and ctx (&mut TxContext) and returns a Player. A public function `add_item` with type parameter T that has key and store, that takes &mut Player and item (T), and adds the item as a dynamic object field keyed by object::id(&item). A public function `remove_item` with type parameter T that has key and store, that takes &mut Player and item_id (ID), removes and returns the T. Use sui::dynamic_object_field. Use Move 2024 edition syntax.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build

evals.prompt: Write a Sui Move module called `test_project::lockbox` that demonstrates object wrapping. Define an Item object (has key, store) with id (UID) and value (u64). Define a Lockbox object (has key) with id (UID) and item (Item) fields — the Item is stored directly as a field inside the Lockbox. Include: a public function `create_item` that takes value (u64) and ctx (&mut TxContext) and returns an Item. A public function `lock` that takes item (Item) by value and ctx (&mut TxContext), wraps it inside a new Lockbox, and transfers the Lockbox to the sender. A public function `unlock` that takes lockbox (Lockbox) by value, unpacks it, deletes the Lockbox UID, and returns the Item. Use Move 2024 edition syntax.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
